info.cls_ename: Department of Aerospace and Systems Engineering
info.sub_ename: PRINCIPLES AND DESIGNS OF ROCKET PROPULSION

description.sub_ename: PRINCIPLES AND DESIGNS OF ROCKET PROPULSION
description.describe_ch: 此課程的主題著眼於火箭推進的基本科技，實用性以及設計原理。企圖提供主題的介紹、基本原理的瞭解，它們關鍵物理機構或設計的描述並理解火箭推進在飛行載具的應用。
description.describe_eh: This course concentrates on the subject of rocket propulsion, its basic technology, performance, and design rationale. The intent is to provide an introduction to the subject, an understanding of basic principles, a description of their key physical mechanisms or designs, and an appreciation of the application of rocket propulsion to flying vehicles.
description.pre_subname: AERO3054噴射推進、AERO2003熱力學(一)、AERO2004熱力學(二)

targets.describe_ch: 瞭解各種推進系統的關鍵應用、定義、基本熱力學與噴嘴理論
targets.describe_en: Give a classification of the various propulsion systems with their key applications, definitions, basic thermodynamics and nozzle theory.

targets.describe_ch: 專注在化學推進原理，包括液體火箭引擎與固體火箭發動機。
targets.describe_en: Devoted to chemical propulsion, namely liquid rocket engines and solid rocket motors.

targets.describe_ch: 專注於利用化學燃燒能量的複合式火箭推進系統。
targets.describe_en: Devoted to hybrid rocket propulsion, another form of using chemical combustion energy.

targets.describe_ch: 各式推進系統的推力向量控制，特定應用的火箭推進系統選擇。
targets.describe_en: Apply to all types of propulsion, namely thrust vector control, selection of a rocket propulsion system for specific application.
